lines.beaver_en: Brother, I called about taking care of Mom.
lines.en: It's already been three years since Dad passed away.

lines.beaver: 형님 생각은 어떠세요? 모시는 게 낫겠죠?
lines.beaver_en: What do you think, brother? Would it be better to take her in?
lines.beaver_roman: hyeongnim saenggageun eotteoseyo? mosineun ge natgetjyo?
lines.learner: 응, 우리 집에서 모실게. 집사람도 찬성했어.
lines.en: Yes, she'll live with us. My wife agreed too.
lines.roman: eung, uri jibeseo mosilge. jipsaramdo chanseonghaesseo.

lines.beaver: 형수님이 고생이 많으시겠어요. 비용도 만만치 않고요.
lines.beaver_en: That'll be hard on your wife. And it's not cheap either.
lines.beaver_roman: hyeongsunimi gosaengi maneusigesseoyo. biyongdo manmanchi ankoyo.
lines.learner: 어디 비용뿐인가? 수발드는 게 더 힘들지.
lines.en: It's not just the cost. The caregiving is harder.
lines.roman: eodi biyongbuninga? subaldeuneun ge deo himdeulji.

lines.beaver_en: I'll chip in for living costs every month.
lines.learner: 고마워. 어머니 수발은 우리 부부가 할게.
lines.en: Thanks. My wife and I will take care of Mom.
lines.roman: gomawo. eomeoni subareun uri bubuga halge.

lines.beaver: 그런데 수진이 얘기도 해야죠. 혼자 아기 키우잖아요.
lines.beaver_en: We should also talk about Sujin. She's raising the baby alone.
lines.beaver_roman: geureonde sujini yaegido haeyajyo. honja agi kiujanayo.
lines.learner: 미혼모라 혼자서 다 해. 아직 산모인데.
lines.en: She's a single mom doing it all alone. She just gave birth.
lines.roman: mihonmora honjaseo da hae. ajik sanmoinde.

lines.beaver_en: I heard baby things cost quite a lot.
lines.learner: 모유가 잘 안 나와서 분유랑 기저귀값이 꽤 든대.
lines.en: She doesn't have much breast milk, so formula and diapers cost a lot.
lines.roman: moyuga jal an nawaseo bunyurang gijeogwigapsi kkwae deundae.

lines.beaver_en: We'll handle that. We'll send them every month.
lines.learner: 고맙다. 집사람한테 말해서 반찬 좀 보낼게.
lines.en: Thanks. I'll tell my wife and send some side dishes.
lines.roman: gomapda. jipsaramhante malhaeseo banchan jom bonaelge.

lines.beaver_en: Sujin had a really hard time during her pregnancy.
lines.learner: 태교도 못 하고 힘들게 낳았잖아. 잘 챙기자.
lines.en: She couldn't even do prenatal care and had a hard birth. Let's look after her.
lines.roman: taegyodo mo tago himdeulge nadatjana. jal chaenggija.

lines.beaver_en: I'm worried Mom might feel lonely.
lines.en: Let's all get together on weekends. We should be good to her.

lines.beaver_en: Sounds good. Let's all get together this weekend.
lines.en: Okay. 'Family harmony' is our family motto, after all.
